# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release gets security fixes. Both apps update themselves, so staying on the newest version is the easiest way to stay safe.

| Version | Supported |
|---|---|
| Latest 2.x release | ✅ |
| Older releases | ❌ |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **don't open a public issue** for security problems. Report them privately instead:

1. Go to the [Security tab](https://github.com/meekwilliam/changemylocation/security) of this repository.
2. Click **Report a vulnerability** and describe the problem, how to reproduce it, and which version and platform you used.

You'll get a reply as soon as possible, usually within a few days. Once a fix is released, you'll be credited in the release notes unless you'd rather not be.

## What counts

Things worth reporting include:

- A way to get the Mac or Windows updater to install something that isn't a real changemylocation release.
- A way for a website, file or another device on the network to make the app do something it shouldn't.
- Anything in a release download that doesn't match the code in this repository.

Apps that detect simulated locations, and Apple's own developer services, aren't changemylocation bugs.
